title: Seshat event document (schema 1.0, ECS 8.11.0)
description: One document emitted by Seshat for any dataset. Documents are nested JSON objects (not dotted keys). The `event.dataset` value selects the dataset definition. ECS groups tolerate extra fields; the `seshat` namespace is closed (vendor-specific data lives in `flattened` fields).

dataset_syslog.$comment: seshat.syslog: syslog messages (RFC 3164, RFC 5424, CEF, LEEF).

dataset_flow.$comment: seshat.flow: flow records (NetFlow, IPFIX, sFlow, NSEL).

dataset_flow_rollup.$comment: seshat.flow_rollup: one-minute flow roll-ups (top talkers, per-interface, per-application).

dataset_tracker.$comment: seshat.tracker: Device Tracker sightings and interval events.

dataset_metric.$comment: seshat.metric: streaming telemetry samples (gNMI, Cisco MDT, Juniper JTI): one document per leaf value.
